careerDirection.directionDescription: Data protection and privacy compliance involves ensuring organisations handle personal data in accordance with DPDP (India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act), GDPR, and sector-specific privacy regulations. GRC analysts assess data handling practices; information security managers implement data protection policies; RegTech analysts automate privacy compliance workflows. BCA Cyber Security graduates with knowledge of data protection law and security controls are positioned for this growing compliance specialisation.

careerDirection.directionDescription: Security automation involves using scripting, RPA, and orchestration tools to automate repetitive security tasks — threat detection, patch management, and compliance scanning. RPA developers build automation workflows; automation engineers design security orchestration systems; emerging technology analysts evaluate new security platforms. BCA Cyber Security graduates with Python scripting and security tool knowledge can build security automation capabilities that are increasingly valued in large enterprise security teams.

careerDirection.directionDescription: Network security and infrastructure protection involves securing the networking layers of an organisation against intrusion, denial of service, and data exfiltration. Network security engineers design and implement firewalls, IPS/IDS systems, and network segmentation; cloud security engineers secure cloud-hosted infrastructure; DevSecOps engineers embed security into software delivery pipelines. The network and protocol knowledge in the BCA Cyber Security curriculum maps directly to these roles.
